EXPLORE SERVICES ↘

HOW I WORK

Strategy when you need direction.
Delivery when you need results.

I'm Marnie. I work with small businesses, founders and independent clients who need more than a list of suggestions. Sometimes the right starting point is research or a clear plan. Sometimes something needs untangling, building or fixing. I can work out the direction and take responsibility for the practical work that follows.

I've managed ecommerce catalogues containing 5,000+ products, built websites from front to back, created Shopify apps and worked across Shopify, Etsy, TikTok Shop and Amazon. I've also developed brands, supported marketing campaigns and publishing projects, researched commercial ideas and turned complicated projects into workable plans. That breadth matters when a problem doesn't fit neatly into one category.

I don't separate strategy from delivery. If I recommend something, I'm thinking about how it will work in practice, what it will cost in time and resources, what could go wrong and whether it makes commercial sense. You'll deal directly with the person doing the work: me.

CLEAR, SENSIBLE PRICING

Small jobs welcome.
Bigger projects quoted properly.

A small job shouldn't require an agency-sized budget, and a full project shouldn't be squeezed into a small-task price. These are starting points for clearly defined work. I'll explain the scope, deliverables and cost before we begin.

STRATEGY & RESEARCH£55/hour
WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT£50/hour
ECOMMERCE & PROJECT SUPPORT£40–£45/hour
ADMINISTRATION SUPPORT£35/hour

Starting prices apply to a defined entry scope. Your written quote confirms the deliverables, client-supplied materials, included revisions, total price and any third-party costs before work begins. Larger requirements and work outside the agreed scope require a separate written quote and approval. Revised prices apply to new enquiries; existing agreements and previously accepted quotes remain unchanged. Dorset Division is not VAT registered and does not charge VAT.

Routine ecommerce and project delivery is £40/hour; specialist ecommerce and project support is £45/hour. The applicable rate and authorised time allowance are agreed before work starts. Website development is £50/hour and strategy and research is £55/hour.

01

Business Strategy, Research & Planning

Business research · Market research · Competitor analysis · Business planning · Commercial research · Process improvement

Have an idea worth exploring but not enough evidence to commit money? Need to understand your competitors, test an assumption or find out why part of the business isn't working? I'll look beyond the obvious, research the options and give you findings you can actually use to decide what happens next.

Focused research from £195Concise business plan from £350Researched commercial business plan from £650Specialist support £55/hr

Explore business strategy & research ↗

Focused research — from £195

Includes and deliverables: One defined commercial question, researched using available public sources, with a written summary of findings, sources and practical next steps.

You supply: The business or idea, the question to answer, existing information and your decision deadline.

Revisions: One consolidated revision round to clarify the agreed findings.

Outside scope: Additional questions, markets, paid data, interviews, extensive prospect lists and implementation are quoted separately.

Concise business plan — from £350

Includes and deliverables: A concise written plan covering the offer, target customers, delivery and high-level costs, based mainly on information you provide.

You supply: Your objectives, business details, customer information, operating assumptions and available cost figures.

Revisions: One consolidated revision round within the agreed brief.

Outside scope: Independent market research, detailed financial forecasts, funding applications and implementation require a separate quote.

Researched commercial business plan — from £650

Includes and deliverables: A written commercial plan supported by an agreed programme of public-source market and competitor research, with sources and practical recommendations. The quote defines the market, research questions and document sections.

You supply: Business objectives, available financial and operating information, known competitors and the intended audience for the plan.

Revisions: One consolidated revision round within the agreed brief.

Outside scope: Additional markets, primary research, paid datasets, detailed financial modelling and funding applications are quoted separately. Commercial results and funding approval are not guaranteed.

That can include front-end and back-end development, Shopify functionality, integrations, client portals and ongoing improvements. A full website involves planning, design, development, responsive testing and proper delivery — and I price it as a complete project, not a quick template job.

You supply: Final copy and licensed images for each page, branding, contact details and suitable hosting or account access.

WHAT WORKING WITH ME IS LIKE

I speak normal.

I communicate professionally without turning a simple conversation into a board meeting. I'll ask questions when I need to, keep you updated and tell you if there's a problem.

No unnecessary jargon. No agency waffle. No pretending something is complicated just to sound clever.

I work independently and don't need every step spoon-fed to me. Give me the objective, the information I need and room to work. If I don't know something, I'll say so. Then I'll research it.

YOUR PROJECT COULD BE NEXT

Got something that needs sorting?

You don't need to arrive with a perfect brief or know which service to choose. Tell me what you're trying to achieve, what's getting in the way and what you've already tried. I'll ask the right questions, tell you whether I can help and explain the sensible next step — including the cost — before we go any further.
